claims.claim_ar: نداء مخاطبة مباشر لـ«أهل الكتاب» لشدّ الانتباه وتحديد المخاطَب، توكيد للعلاقة الخطابية والاتهام المباشر.
claims.claim_en: Direct vocative address to 'People of the Book' to catch attention and specify the addressees; it focuses the rebuke and establishes the auditorial relationship.

claims.claim_ar: توكيد المفارقة بين موقفهم من الآيات (السخرية والاستهزاء) وبين وضعِهم كـ«شهود» — قراءة بلاغية تقرِئ الآية كإظهار التنافر بين الشهادة الفعلية والإنكار/السخرية.
claims.claim_en: An antithesis/contrast: the commentary highlights the paradox between their mockery of the revealed verses and their status as 'witnesses' — a rhetorical contrast read into the verse between testimony and denial/mockery.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted commentary explicitly mentions their mockery of verses; the linkage to the phrase 'وأنتم تشهدون' (witnessing) is interpretive/inferential rather than an explicit contiguous quote in the provided chunks.

warnings: Source chunks provided are commentary excerpts (mainly al-Kashshaf) and do not contain every word/phrase of the ayah verbatim; some rhetorical readings are inferred from the commentary rather than quoted directly from a chunk that includes the full ayah.

Only substrings actually present in the provided chunks were used as source_quote_ar. Claims that connect different parts of the ayah to commentary may require review if additional primary/commentary sources (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir-balagha) are expected.

Some device classifications (e.g., labeling the vocative as 'iltifat') follow a broad rhetorical taxonomy; if you require alternative labels (e.g., 'vocative' vs. 'iltifat') or finer-grained subtypes, indicate preferred taxonomy.
